modalLead: A small follow-up: dragging a bookmark now explains itself when a category is sorted A–Z or Recent.

items.text: Clearer why a bookmark won't drag — when a category is sorted A–Z or Recent, its bookmarks can't be dragged to reorder (the sort would just undo it). Previously nothing happened, which looked broken. Now the category shows a hover tooltip, a not-allowed cursor, and a one-off note when you try to drag — reminding you to switch that category back to manual order first. A plain click still opens the bookmark.
